'''Sara''' is the cook at the [[Stag and Lion]] in [[Baerlon]], a town in [[Andor]].

==Activities==
Sara has a cat named [[Cirri]], who she defends when Master [[Fitch]] complains about the dead rats Cirri leaves lying around.{{ref/book|1|15}}
